svg.text: How much sterling silver does a month of average income buy?
GNI per capita (Atlas, USD) ÷ silver price × 0.925 (sterling = 92.5 % silver), grams per month · shared log scale
grams of sterling silver per month (log scale)
Data: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet), silver USD/troy oz; World Bank WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.CD (GNI per capita, Atlas method)
Metal value only (no making charge). Silver prices are rounded to 0.1 USD by the source — up to ~10 % in the 1960s. No USSR income in USD; Russia from 1991, Poland from 1992.
